entry.title: Identifying Necessary Transparency Moments In Agentic AI (Part 1)
entry.summary: Designing for agentic AI requires attention to both the system’s behavior and the transparency of its actions. Between the black box and the data dump lies a more thoughtful approach. Victor Yocco explores how to map decision points and reveal the right moments to build trust through clarity, not noise.
